life.text: 教学示例情境：在咖啡店点一杯小杯不加糖的热咖啡。

communication.text: 教学示例情境：没有听清对方说明，请对方说慢一点，并重说最后一句。
communication.answer: Could you speak a little more slowly and repeat the last sentence, please?

work.text: 教学示例：The office will be closed on Friday. Please submit your report by Thursday at 3 p.m. 任务：读懂应该何时交报告。
